concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading ≥50,000 clips from the CHiME-5 dataset, but the Assumptions section states the data will be sourced from the 'Voices-in-the-Wild-2M' dataset. This contradicts the required dataset source and undermines the power analysis tied to CHiME-5.

FR-005 specifies that the regression target must be the curve parameters (inflection point, slope) derived from the full stress curve, whereas FR-021 defines the 'collapse intensity' as a scalar intensity based on SSS < 0.5 and WER thresholds. The two definitions of the target variable are inconsistent.

FR-010 requires normalizing the SSS collapse threshold relative to each model's clean‑audio baseline, but FR-021 uses an absolute SSS < 0.5 threshold without any baseline normalization. This creates a conflict in how the collapse point is computed.
The document alternates between calling the user journeys 'User Story 1' and referencing them as 'US-1', 'US-2', etc. Consistent terminology should be used throughout to avoid ambiguity.
